sentences.en: He said last time to Goebbels, after visiting Paris, he said, you know, I'm going to make a last offer to the British.
sentences.zh: 他上次在参观完巴黎后对戈培尔说，你知道的，我要向英国人发出最后一次提议。

sentences.en: I'm going to make them a generous offer, and hopefully they will finally see sense.
sentences.zh: 我要向他们提出一个慷慨的提议，希望他们最终能认清现实。

sentences.en: And is that in part because he has, you know, his perspective is very continentaliSt.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是否是因为他的视角非常大陆化？

sentences.en: He assumes that if the British have left the continent, then essentially they've lost the war.
sentences.zh: 他假设只要英国人撤出了欧洲大陆，那么他们本质上就已经输掉了战争。

sentences.en: And he doesn't properly have a handle on the kind of global dimension that Britain can bring to the conflict.
sentences.zh: 而且他并没有真正掌握英国能够给这场冲突带来的那种全球维度的力量。

sentences.en: I don't think it's that, actually.
sentences.zh: 其实我不认为是这样。

sentences.en: I think in a weird way, what Hitler does is he overestimates the importance of the British empire to Britain.
sentences.zh: 我觉得从某种诡异的角度来看，希特勒是高估了大英帝国对英国的重要性。

sentences.en: That will sound weird to a lot of listeners.
sentences.zh: 这听起来对很多听众来说会很奇怪。

sentences.en: That is interesting.
sentences.zh: 这倒很有意思。

sentences.en: No, that is interesting.
sentences.zh: 不，这确实很有意思。

sentences.en: So Hitler looks at it and he thinks, if you carry on fighting, if you exhaust your resources in trying to fight me, you'll probably lose your empire.
sentences.zh: 所以希特勒看待这个问题时认为，如果你继续打下去，如果你在试图与我对抗的过程中耗尽了资源，你可能会失去你的帝国。

sentences.en: Spoiler alert, that's exactly what happens.
sentences.zh: 剧透警告，这正是后来发生的事情。

sentences.en: He thinks, well, obviously the British would only care about their empire.
sentences.zh: 他心想，很显然英国人只在乎他们的帝国。

sentences.en: Nothing would matter more to them than being strong and influential in the world.
sentences.zh: 没有什么比在世界上保持强大和有影响力更重要的了。

sentences.en: You know, Churchill, who loves the empire more than anybody, presides over a war that basically destroys Britain's ability to keep hold of its empire.
sentences.zh: 你知道，比任何人都要热爱帝国的丘吉尔，却在一场基本上摧毁了英国保持其帝国能力的大战中主持大局。

sentences.en: I mean, that's the kind of irony of the whole thing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就是整件事情的讽刺之处。

sentences.en: Anyway, Hitler's planning to give this big speech where he's going to make this offer.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，希特勒正计划发表这篇大演讲，在其中提出这项提议。

sentences.en: And he plans initially to give it on the 8th of July, which is two days after he's got home from France.
sentences.zh: 他最初计划在 7 月 8 日发表，也就是他从法国回家两天后。

sentences.en: But he postpones it.
sentences.zh: 但他推迟了。

sentences.en: And the reason he postpones it is because of a really interesting development in North Africa.
sentences.zh: 他推迟的原因是北非发生了一个非常有趣的发展。

sentences.en: The French had the fourth biggest fleet in the world, and Churchill was desperate to stop it falling into German hands.
sentences.zh: 法国拥有世界上第四大海军舰队，而丘吉尔极其渴望阻止它落入德国手中。

sentences.en: And he doesn't trust Marshal Pétain's assurances that they won't let that happen.
sentences.zh: 而且他根本不相信贝当元帅关于绝不让这种事发生的保证。

sentences.en: I mean, he does kind of, he gives the French fleet in Merzell-Kabir an ultimatum, doesn't he?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他确实这么做了，他向凯比尔港的法国舰队下了最后通牒，不是吗？

sentences.en: And British officers kind of plead with the French to do it.
sentences.zh: 英国军官甚至恳求法国人照做。

sentences.en: And it's when they say no, that the decision is taken.
sentences.zh: 正是在遭到拒绝时，这个决定被做出了。

sentences.en: And that decision is a reflection of the fact that the British are prepared to be incredibly brutal themselves in their fight for survival.
sentences.zh: 而这个决定反映出一个事实，即英国人在为生存而战时，准备采取极其冷酷无情的手段。

sentences.en: So just to explain to the listeners, this is in Algeria, a place called Meuse-el-Kabir, where the French Mediterranean fleet is based.
sentences.zh: 所以向听众解释一下，这是在阿尔及利亚一个叫做凯比尔港的地方，法国地中海舰队的基地。

sentences.en: And as you say to them, the British basically give them an ultimatum, their own allies.
sentences.zh: 正如你对他们所说的那样，英国人基本上对他们自己的盟友下了最后通牒。

sentences.en: Join us, hand yourselves over to us, we'll destroy you.
sentences.zh: 加入我们，向我们投降，否则我们就消灭你们。

sentences.en: The French don't do it, and so the British destroy them and kill more than a thousand French sailors.
sentences.zh: 法国人没有照做，于是英国人摧毁了他们，并杀死了千余名法国水兵。

sentences.en: The Vichy government, you know, Pétain, who was already quite down on the British, says this is the worst betrayal in human history.
sentences.zh: 维希政府，也就是贝当——他本来就对英国人相当不满——称这是人类历史上最可怕的背叛。

sentences.en: He breaks off diplomatic relations with Britain.
sentences.zh: 他断绝了与英国的外交关系。

sentences.en: It sends a really clear signal to the world.
sentences.zh: 这向全世界发出了一个非常清晰的信号。

sentences.en: Yeah, it does.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: Britain's not messing around.
sentences.zh: 英国人可不是在开玩笑。

sentences.en: You know, Churchill's not going to be doing any deals.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，丘吉尔根本不会跟他们谈条件。

sentences.en: We're really going to do whatever it takes.
sentences.zh: 我们真的会不惜一切代价。

sentences.en: And the Germans had hoped they would get the French fleet and that would help them win control of the Channel if they had to.
sentences.zh: 德国人原本希望他们能得到法国舰队，如果非得这么做的话，这能帮他们赢得海峡的控制权。

sentences.en: I mean, it now means they have to win control of the skies if they're going to get across the channel.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，现在这意味着如果他们想穿过海峡，就必须赢得制空权。

sentences.en: So that's, you know, it's preparing the ground for the Battle of Britain.
sentences.zh: 所以你看，这就是在为不列颠之战做准备。

sentences.en: But of course, it gives Hitler pause for thought.
sentences.zh: 但当然，这也让希特勒犹豫不决起来。

sentences.en: So now he postpones the speech.
sentences.zh: 于是现在他推迟了演讲。

sentences.en: Interestingly, he doesn't really know what to do.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，他其实不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: In this episode, we will see Hitler at his most indecisive and confused because the British are not just not behaving as he thinks they ought to.
sentences.zh: 在这集里，我们将看到优柔寡断、迷茫至极的希特勒，因为英国人的行为完全不符合他的预期。

sentences.en: So he talks to Goebbels again.
sentences.zh: 所以他又去找戈培尔谈了谈。

sentences.en: And Goebbels records in his diary on the 9th of July, despite all this, the Fuhrer still has a very positive attitude towards England.
sentences.zh: 戈培尔在7月9日的日记中写道，尽管如此，元首对英国仍然抱有非常积极的态度。

sentences.en: He's still not ready for the final blow.
sentences.zh: 他还没准备好发出致命一击。

sentences.en: He wants to think over his speech again in peace.
sentences.zh: 他想安安静静地重新考虑一下他的演讲。

sentences.en: So Hitler postpones the speech.
sentences.zh: 于是希特勒推迟了演讲。

sentences.en: He goes off to his mountain lair, the Ober Salzberg in southern Germany, and he summons his military chiefs.
sentences.zh: 他前往他在德国南部的山间隐秘住所——上萨尔茨堡，并召集了他的军事将领们。

sentences.en: So first of all, Grand Admiral Erich Rader, who is the head of the Kriegsmarine, the Navy High Command.
sentences.zh: 首先是海军元帅埃里希·雷德尔，他是战争海军（即海军最高指挥部）的负责人。

sentences.en: Now, Raider is a, you know, your classic kind of career naval officer, conservative Prussian family, right wing.
sentences.zh: 雷德尔嘛，你知道的，就是那种典型的职业海军军官，保守的普鲁士家庭出身，右翼分子。

sentences.en: He has been working since 1939 on invasion plans for Britain.
sentences.zh: 他从1939年起就开始制定入侵英国的计划了。

sentences.en: And he knows that this is a massive challenge because his navy has taken a hammering in the Norway campaign.
sentences.zh: 他深知这是一项巨大的挑战，因为他的海军在挪威战役中遭到了沉重打击。

sentences.en: Of course, the Bluka got blown up, didn't it?
sentences.zh: 当然，“布吕歇尔”号被炸沉了，对吧？

sentences.en: The Bluka got blown up by the Norwegians very heroically.
sentences.zh: “布吕歇尔”号被挪威人非常英勇地炸沉了。

sentences.en: Well done, the Norwegians.
sentences.zh: 干得漂亮，挪威人。

sentences.en: So Raider has three cruisers and four destroyers that he can call on in the Channel.
sentences.zh: 所以雷德尔在海峡里能调动的只有三艘巡洋舰和四艘驱逐舰。

sentences.en: And the British Channel fleet is five battleships, 11 cruisers and 30 destroyers.
sentences.zh: 而英国海峡舰队拥有五艘战列舰、11艘巡洋舰和30艘驱逐舰。

sentences.en: So the odds are very, very clearly in Britain's favour.
sentences.zh: 所以双方的胜算非常非常明显地倾向于英国这边。

sentences.en: One thing to consider is that we don't like having the advantage of numbers.
sentences.zh: 有一点需要考虑的是，我们其实不太喜欢占有人数优势。

sentences.en: So perhaps we'd be unsettled by that.
sentences.zh: 所以这或许会让我们感到不安。

sentences.en: We'd be unsettled by the odds being in our favour.
sentences.zh: 胜算在我们这一边，这反而会让我们心里没底。

sentences.en: We always perform pluckily and generally win when the odds are against us.
sentences.zh: 当处境对我们不利时，我们一向表现顽强，而且通常能赢。

sentences.en: But I think we often do even better when the odds are in our favour.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得，当胜算站在我们这边时，我们往往能表现得更好。

sentences.en: So I think it's just win-win, really.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得这绝对是稳赚不赔的买卖。

sentences.en: That's just the nature of it, and I don't want any complaints from people who don't pay their taxes on the other side of the Atlantic.
sentences.zh: 这就是它的本质，我可不想听到大西洋彼岸那些不交税的人有任何抱怨。

sentences.en: So then Hitler receives the Wehrmacht Chief of Staff General, Franz Halder.
sentences.zh: 接下来，希特勒接见了德军总参谋长弗朗茨·哈尔德将军。

sentences.en: Halder was the bloke, the kind of clipped guy with glasses who was trying to get rid of Hitler in episode one of this little bit of the series.
sentences.zh: 哈尔德就是那个家伙，那个戴着眼镜、说话简短利索的家伙，在本系列的上一集里，他还曾试图除掉希特勒。

sentences.en: And had given up, hadn't he?
sentences.zh: 结果后来放弃了，对吧？

sentences.en: And had given up, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，确实放弃了。

sentences.en: Again, Halder is very – he can see that Hitler doesn't know what to do.
sentences.zh: 同样，哈尔德非常清楚——他能看出希特勒不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: He writes afterwards, the Fuhrer is greatly puzzled by England's persisting unwillingness to make peace.
sentences.zh: 他事后写道，元首对英国执意不肯求和感到十分困惑。

sentences.en: He sees the answer, as we do, now this is interesting, in England's hope in Russia, and therefore counts on having to compel her by main force to agree to peace.
sentences.zh: 和我们一样，他认为答案在于英国对俄国的指望，因此这就很有意思了，他指望着用武力强迫英国同意媾和。

sentences.en: Actually, that's much against his grain.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这非常违背他的意愿。

sentences.en: So it's interesting that Halder thinks that the British are hoping that Russia will change sides.
sentences.zh: 所以有趣的是，哈尔德认为英国人是寄希望于俄国会倒戈。

sentences.en: Then he goes on.
sentences.zh: 然后他继续说道。

sentences.en: The reason that Hitler doesn't want to do it, really, is that a military defeat of England would bring about the disintegration of the British Empire.
sentences.zh: 希特勒之所以真的不想这么做，是因为在军事上击败英国将导致大英帝国的瓦解。

sentences.en: This would not be of any benefit to Germany.
sentences.zh: 这对德国没有任何好处。

sentences.en: German blood would be shed to accomplish something that would benefit only Japan, the United States, and others.
sentences.zh: 德国人的流血牺牲最终只能让日本、美国和其他国家受益。

sentences.en: So again, the Germans don't want to see the British Empire fall apart.
sentences.zh: 所以同样地，德国人并不想看到大英帝国分崩离析。

sentences.en: Preserving that is really important, their long-term plan for the conquest of the planet.
sentences.zh: 保留大英帝国对于他们征服全球的长期计划至关重要。

sentences.en: Hitler is speaking to an admiral and to a general.
sentences.zh: 希特勒正在跟一位海军元帅和一位陆军将军谈话。

sentences.en: And again, I was talking about this with my brother.
sentences.zh: 话说回来，我之前跟我兄弟聊过这事。

sentences.en: He said, the mad thing about this is that there's no kind of combined services general staff.
sentences.zh: 他说，最疯狂的地方在于，根本没有什么三军联合总参谋部。

sentences.en: So the Admiral and the General are not talking to each other.
sentences.zh: 所以海军元帅和陆军将军根本不互相沟通。

sentences.en: So all the planning for kind of amphibious campaign, they have no concept of how to launch an amphibious campaign because the Navy and the Army aren't talking to each other.
sentences.zh: 因此所有关于两栖战役的计划，他们根本没有概念该如何发起一场两栖战役，因为海军和陆军根本不交流。

sentences.en: And also the man running the Luftwaffe is an extremely unreliable man who's more interested in like hunting trophies and looted art and eating, and that's Hermann Göring.
sentences.zh: 而且管理空军的那家伙也是个极其靠不住的人，他更热衷于收集狩猎战利品、掠夺艺术品以及吃喝，这人就是赫尔曼·戈林。

sentences.en: And I think it is really difficult when you're looking at German prospects in 1940.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，当你审视1940年德国的前景时，会发现情况真的很棘手。

sentences.en: They have done so well.
sentences.zh: 他们干得太出色了。

sentences.en: They have kind of obliterated everybody in their face.
sentences.zh: 他们几乎把眼前的一切对手都消灭得精光。

sentences.en: And yet there is still this kind of makeshift degree of incompetence about the organisation of the armed forces that is kind of lurking there and will slowly emerge over the course of the next years.
sentences.zh: 然而，武装部队的组织结构中仍然弥漫着这种临时凑合般的无能，它潜伏在那里，并将在未来几年里慢慢显现出来。

sentences.en: Yeah, and over the course of this episode, actually.
sentences.zh: 是的，实际上在这一集里就会显现出来。

sentences.en: Now, there is another option, there is another possibility about how to bring Britain to heel.
sentences.zh: 现在，还有另一个选择，另一种让英国屈服的可能性。

sentences.en: And this is that you could get a fifth columnist to do your job for you.
sentences.zh: 那就是你可以找一个第五纵队（内奸）来为你代劳。

sentences.en: Now, while he's at his lair, Hitler says to his cronies, God, I wish I'd worked harder to win over Edward VIII.
sentences.zh: 在隐居地期间，希特勒对他的亲信们说：“天哪，我真希望当初能花更多力气去争取温莎公爵（爱德华八世）。”

sentences.en: when he was king you know and he's also muttering about oswald mosley mosley's under arrest at this
sentences.zh: 当他还是国王的时候，你知道的，而且他还在那儿嘟囔着奥斯瓦尔德·莫斯利，此时莫斯利已经被捕了

sentences.en: point the leader of the british union of fascists and actually somebody who really likes the idea
sentences.zh: 他是英国法西斯联盟的领袖，实际上他非常赞同爱德华八世的想法

sentences.en: of edward the eighth who is now of course has abdicated because of his relationship with
sentences.zh: 而爱德华八世因为与沃利斯·辛普森的关系现在当然已经退位了

sentences.en: wallace simpson and he's become the duke of windsor somebody who really likes the idea of using him
sentences.zh: 他成为了温莎公爵，有一个人非常喜欢利用他的想法

sentences.en: is the top german sparkling wine salesman joachim von ribbentrop who'd been a pastor to britain and now foreign minister, one of the worst people who's ever lived.
sentences.zh: 这个人就是德国顶级起泡酒销售员约阿希姆·冯·里宾特洛甫，他曾担任过驻英大使，现在是外交部长，也是世上有史以来最糟糕的人之一。

sentences.en: Ribbentrop, because he hated Britain.
sentences.zh: 里宾特洛甫这么做，是因为他痛恨英国。

sentences.en: I mean, he really does hate Britain.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他是真的恨英国。

sentences.en: And he thinks, let's bring back the worst king in British history.
sentences.zh: 他心想，让我们把英国历史上最糟糕的国王请回来吧。

sentences.en: This is a brilliant idea.
sentences.zh: 这主意简直绝了。

sentences.en: Now, this is a mad story.
sentences.zh: 现在，这真是一个荒诞的故事。

sentences.en: Edward and Wallace are in Portugal.
sentences.zh: 爱德华和沃利斯当时在葡萄牙。

sentences.en: They are going around telling everybody Britain has lost and should make peace with the Nazis.
sentences.zh: 他们到处跟人说英国已经输了，应该跟纳粹讲和。

sentences.en: And Ribbentrop goes to this bloke and gets an SS officer called Walter Schellenberg and says, I want you to do a job for me.
sentences.zh: 里宾特洛甫找到这家伙，找了一个叫沃尔特·施伦贝格的党卫军军官，并说道：“我要你帮我办件事。”

sentences.en: Basically, I want you to lure them across the border into Franco's Spain.
sentences.zh: 基本上，我要你把他们诱骗过境，进入弗朗哥统治下的西班牙。

sentences.en: And then this is how it will work.
sentences.zh: 然后计划是这样的。

sentences.en: Edward and Wallace will be invited to go hunting on the Portuguese border with Spain.
sentences.zh: 爱德华和沃利斯将被邀请去葡萄牙与西班牙边境打猎。

sentences.en: Their guides will trick them and lure them across the border into Spain.
sentences.zh: 他们的向导会耍花招，把他们诱骗跨过边境进入西班牙。

sentences.en: And there they'll be kidnapped by German agents.
sentences.zh: 然后他们就会被德国特工绑架。

sentences.en: And then they will take Edward to a safe house and offer him 50 million francs to accept the British crown as a Nazi puppet.
sentences.zh: 接着他们会把爱德华带到一个安全屋，并提供5000万法郎，让他接受英国王位，成为纳粹的傀儡。

sentences.en: And he'd probably have taken it, wouldn't he?
sentences.zh: 他大概会接受吧，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, and he's quite a bad man, so he might have taken it.
sentences.zh: 是的，他本来就不是什么好人，所以他很可能会接受。

sentences.en: So here's the thing.
sentences.zh: 所以情况是这样的。

sentences.en: Ribbentrop knows that the British wouldn't like this.
sentences.zh: 里宾特洛甫知道英国人不会喜欢这样。

sentences.en: He actually thinks that it might make an invasion more likely, but he loves that idea because he really wants to invade Britain.
sentences.zh: 他甚至认为这可能会增加入侵的可能性，但他很喜欢这个主意，因为他做梦都想入侵英国。

sentences.en: He hates Britain.
sentences.zh: 他恨英国。

sentences.en: He wants to see as many British people die as possible.
sentences.zh: 他想看到尽可能多的英国人死去。

sentences.en: And he wants to force all those gentlemen's clubs to give him honorary membership.
sentences.zh: 他还想强迫所有那些绅士俱乐部授予他荣誉会员资格。

sentences.en: And all those tailors who'd laugh at his shoes or whatever, his ill-fitting suits.
sentences.zh: 还有所有那些曾经嘲笑他的鞋子或者他不合身的西装的裁缝们。
